title: Uttarakhand: Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) workers’ protest over DA hike, job security intensifies

ai.summary: PRD workers in Uttarakhand intensified protests over demands for 365-day employment and DA matching Home Guards after inconclusive talks with the Sports and Youth Welfare minister.

facts.claim: PRD workers locked the gate of the Directorate of Youth Welfare in protest
facts.quote: Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) workers on Thursday locked the gate of the Directorate of Youth Welfare in protest after a meeting with Minister Rekha Arya over their demand for 365 days of employment and Dearness Allowance (DA) at par with Home Guards.

facts.claim: They were summoned to meet the minister to discuss demands
facts.quote: The PRD personnel said that they had been summoned to the secretariat to meet Arya, the Sports and Youth Welfare minister, to discuss their demands.

facts.claim: The minister said the department is empathetic and will review demands
facts.quote: Arya said the department is empathetic toward the PRD personnel and said they are a major strength of the department, acknowledging their services during the Char Dham Yatra.

facts.claim: The minister urged patience and promised a proposal
facts.quote: She urged the PRD personnel to be patient and said the department will prepare a proposal that aligns with their sentiments.

ai.background_note: PRD workers in Uttarakhand have been protesting for 365-day employment and DA matching Home Guards since at least November 19, 2026.
